description: Provisions the Microsoft Photos app for all users from its Store bundle and dependencies. Windows adds it to the user at their next sign-in. Exit code 10 means Photos is already provisioned on the PC.
symptoms: I cannot open pictures, there is no Photos app
برنامه Photos ویندوز روی سیستم نیست
عکس‌ها باز نمی‌شوند چون برنامه Photos ندارم

review.source: Microsoft.Windows.Photos msixbundle and its dependency packages from the Microsoft Store for Business / winget download (msstore id 9WZDNCRFJBH4).
review.notes: Bundle not committed. Place it with scripts/set-package-files.ps1 -Id photos-install -File <bundle and dependency .appx/.msix files> -Sign; the bundle is stored as Microsoft.Windows.Photos.msixbundle, an optional license as Microsoft.Windows.Photos-license.xml.
